text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Where has the sacred banner launched into 
the sky fallen?! 
Read the winds, warriors!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Is there anyone who can claim it before 
me?! 
Who shall be the one to carry the banner 
to the hilltop?!

text_block_list.name: Participating Horsegirls
text_block_list.text:
"I will--!" "Uwoooogh!" 
"Yaaaahhhhhh--!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Shinme shared their wealth of 
experience 
with participants of each program, 
continually 
elevating the caliber of the performances.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching over them, I offer a silent 
prayer.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Taaah!

text_block_list.name: Officials & Participants
text_block_list.text:
"Ooooh, she pulled it all the way!" 
"As expected of Yukino-chan...!" 
"I've gotta follow her lead!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*chime*)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...All the feelin's everyone gave me, 
they're restin' right here inside my 
heart.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
A truly dazzling display. 
All of the visiting spectators have 
offered 
glowing praise for our Shinme.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: ...And now.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...The final year is about to begin. 
There is something I wish to bestow upon 
you all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text: Please accept these.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: What are these...?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
They are known as "musubi-ita"--tablets of 
binding.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Upon this tablet, one inscribes 
the bond they hold most precious of all.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Before the final program, the Votive 
Dance, 
we ask that each of you dedicate yours.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Before Maya's Votive Dance? 
...Can we write whatever we want?

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Yes. "Bonds with the people of my 
hometown," 
"a vow with my partner"... Or simply 
the name of the person dearest to you.

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
Before the dance, they shall be consigned 
to ritual flames 
and offered to the heavens. As proof of 
our unbreakable bonds.

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: A bond to hold dear...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...This tablet might be a mite too small 
to fit everything on, though. 
There's just so much I wanna write.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, we won't be needin' those tablets 
till much later! 
More importantly, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What's our next move? 
Have you already drawn up our training 
regimen?
choice_data_list: I'm going to decide that right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First, I need to work out a training 
policy together with <chrname>.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Word of their success has also brought in 
new 
horsegirls wishing to participate. If 
possible, 
I'd like them to take part in the programs 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There's a mountain of other work to 
tackle, too. 
I should take things one steady step at a 
time--

text_block_list.name: Azuma
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-sama. 
How shall you offer the final prayer of 
this year?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the horsegirls' growth, 
--let's offer up a brand-new prayer.
